name: Graphite-like SVN toolkit (CLI, service, and web UI)

mentions.name: Graphite-like SVN toolkit (CLI, service, and web UI)
mentions.description: A Graphite-like experience for SVN focused on stacked changes. The project comprises a modern CLI for interacting with SVN, a companion subsystem that runs alongside the SVN repository (similar to gitaly), and a web UI for browsing the repo and doing code reviews.
mentions.problem: The SVN CLI workflow is dated and lacks a modern stacked-diff experience.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I noticed that the SVN CLI workflow is a bit dated and I think there's room to create a graphite like experience for svn, especially focusing on stacking.

I am set out to:
- create a modern CLI to interact with SVN

- create a subsystem to run alongside the svn repo (similar to gitaly)

- create a good looking web UI to browser the repo, review code reviews, etc
